stem: Meera tests a colourless liquid from her kitchen with three indicators and records the results shown. Which conclusion about the liquid is correct?

options.text: The liquid is acidic because it turns blue litmus paper red.
The liquid is basic because turmeric solution stays yellow with it.
The liquid is neutral because none of the three indicators changes colour.
The liquid is acidic because turmeric solution turns reddish-brown with it.

teacher.key_rationale: Blue litmus turning red is the decisive positive test for an acid; red litmus staying red and turmeric staying yellow are consistent with an acid and rule out basic (turmeric would turn reddish-brown) and neutral (blue litmus would not turn red). Only A combines all three rows into a justified label; B and C conflict with the litmus results, and D cites a false turmeric observation.
